modules.practice:
Produce a four-page fictional portfolio: one page of facts/unknowns, one of professional questions and boundaries, one evidence-appraisal table and one further-training plan. Include eight authoritative sources with correct scope and a clear statement that no child was assessed or treated.

Use the downloadable fictional-case and portfolio sheet for complete supplied cases, required sections and review prompts.
modules.assessment: Write a two-page research proposal linked to the case, then ask a consenting adult partner to challenge its outcome meaning, cultural/access assumptions and causal claims. Revise it and record which questions still require a qualified academic or clinical supervisor. If a consenting adult partner is unavailable, write the three strongest counterarguments yourself and label this self-review; do not invent partner feedback. Independent qualified feedback remains a separate next step.
